utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll keep an eye out and let you know the exact spot for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Eli — I’m still only hearing bits second-hand, so I appreciate it. Let me know the exact spot when you can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, it’s still moving along, and I’ll let everyone know the start time as soon as it’s set. I’ll keep it low-key and repeat the plan once everything’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, great — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along what’s been gathered so far. Just let me know when the start time’s set, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the exact location and time for the repair drive, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have it. Once I do, I can tell you whether you need to bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’ll let me know the exact location and time as soon as you have them, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can pass along the details if you tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Noah — could you share the repair list and let me know which job needs the most hands?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still confirming the exact spot and start time for the repair drive, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — I’ve got the move to Sunday at the community center, and I’ll share the exact spot and start time as soon as we confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Mara — I’m still watching for the exact spot they set up, and I’ll let you know as soon as I see it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still watching for the setup spot, and I’ll pass along the exact location as soon as I see it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. Just let me know where to go when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to put your name down or swing by with the details?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m still waiting on the exact spot and time. Once I know, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still waiting on the exact time and spot for the repair drive, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I have it. Then I can tell you if you need to bring gloves or tape.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep waiting on the exact time and spot, then I can note down any gloves or tape folks should bring.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Could you start with the repair drive details? Just the first item is enough, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the exact spot for the repair drive first, then confirm the start time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if you need tools for the repair drive, I’ve got a few you can borrow. Just let me know what you’re fixing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — I’ll keep track of the tools list and let you know what’s still needed once I hear what we’re fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What’s been gathered so far for the repair drive, and do you have the start time yet?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve heard a few tools and supplies have been gathered, but I don’t have the full list yet. I’m still checking on the start time and will pass it along as soon as I know.
